title: powerops diff --format json
description: The JSON written by 'powerops diff --format json': the changes between two versions of a solution, grouped by component kind in a fixed order and sorted by key.

component.description: The kind of component or the part of the solution that differs.

key.description: What identifies the component: a logical name, schema name, flow id or app name. Never a file path.

name.description: Display name, present when the key is an id (flows).

detail.description: For a changed item, 'field: old → new' parts joined with '; '.

risks.description: Risk labels. removed-component: a managed upgrade deletes the component. flow-state: a cloud flow was turned on or off. connection-reference and environment-variable: one was added or removed. agent-tool: an agent tool was added or removed. agent-instructions: an agent's instructions changed. same-version: the two solutions differ but carry the same version number, so importing the new one is not an upgrade: deploy plan skips it.

notCompared.description: What the two solutions hold that diff means to compare but couldn't read, one sentence each, also printed as note: lines on stderr: an agent whose instructions aren't read in one version (no single Custom GPT component whose instructions are text, and no configuration.json segments it reads), an agent whose configuration.json instructions differ from its Custom GPT component's or can't be read (only the component's are compared), and an agent's components it doesn't read as tools or Work IQ workloads. Empty when it read all of it: an empty list means the instructions, tools and Work IQ workloads of each agent were read, not that the agent is equal, because its authentication mode, recognizer, other settings, components of other types and the names, descriptions and states of its tools are never compared. Kinds diff never compares (tables, forms and so on) are not listed; docs/COMMANDS.md names them.
